messages:
Maya: Quick check — I'm about to merge a refactor that bumps the k8s/service module minor version and hoists provider blocks. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/476. Can someone sanity-check secrets path mapping and lockfile regen?

Arjun: ping — what's changing to secrets exactly? will consumers need to change the path or is there a compatibility shim?

Maya: Only moving the module output secret path from secret/data/infra/k8s/service -> secret/data/infra/k8s/service/v2. I added a backfill script in the PR that copies existing keys into the v2 path. The risk is callers that reference the old path directly in helm values or kustomize overlays.

Tasha: I ran a canary plan in staging. Two related things: 1) tf providers lock changed (new checksums) and CI failed initially, 2) plan shows 3 kubernetes_secret resources as -/+ replace. Snippet: 
```
# plan excerpt
-/+ kubernetes_secret.my-app (replace)
    id: "old" => (known after apply)
```
Looks like the provider aliasing got lost when hoisting.

Maya: Hm, I intended to keep provider alias usage. I probably removed the alias when I hoisted the provider to root. Easy fix is to pass provider = kubernetes.alias in the module call or re-add alias mapping on the root provider.

Liam: Also FYI CI fails on `terraform init -lockfile=readonly` because the lockfile changed; the pipeline expects no lockfile drift. We should either regenerate the lockfile in CI or pin the provider version exactly.

Arjun: Quick checklist:
1) Add explicit provider = kubernetes.alias to module call to avoid implicit provider switch.
2) Run `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64` and commit the regenerated lockfile.
3) Run the backfill script in dry-run against staging vault: `scripts/backfill-secret-paths --env=staging --dry-run` and verify `vault kv get` output.

Maya: I'll push a fix for provider aliasing + regenerate the lockfile. I'll also expand the backfill to preserve metadata so consumers see no change. Will do a staged apply only in staging first and then canary to prod.

Tasha: Nits: add a short tf-lint ignore for the resources that will be replaced to avoid noisy lint failures, and update module changelog calling out stateful secret path change.

Liam: Once you push the lockfile update, can you run `make workspace-plan ENV=staging`? I'll watch the plan output. :eyes:

infra-bot: CI: terraform-init -> providers lock changed, running plan in workspace "staging".

Maya: pushed provider alias and new lockfile. Ran backfill dry-run and it prints zero diffs. Plan in staging is now clean (no replaces). Scheduling canary apply for tomorrow AM for 10min watch window. :thumbsup:

Arjun: Thanks — please ping when canary is done and include the backfill run log snippet.

Tasha: LGTM on the fix. Add a tiny note in PR about rollback steps if the backfill fails.

Maya: Will do. Thanks all.
